metadata.exam-title: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Database Engineer
metadata.description: Scenario-Based Study Guide for Professional Cloud Database Engineer certification - validates skills in designing, managing, and troubleshooting Google Cloud database solutions.

question.title: Question 1
question.scenario: You are preparing for the Google Cloud Professional Cloud Database Engineer certification exam.
question.question-text: Which Google Cloud service is a fully managed, serverless data warehouse?

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: BigQuery is a serverless data warehouse optimized for analytics.

question.title: Question 2
question.scenario: You are preparing for the Google Cloud Professional Cloud Database Engineer certification exam.
question.question-text: Which database is globally distributed with strong consistency?

hint.label: Complete Explanation

hint.label: Complete Explanation
